title: Apollo 11 'halfway to the moon' window footage faked in Earth orbit

tellings.quote: There's also the uncovered footage that BART has that shows them saying that they're 230,000 miles out or or 30,000 halfway, right?

plain: The claim is that film shot during Apollo 11, the 1969 mission that put men on the moon, shows the astronauts saying they were about halfway to the moon when they were really still close to Earth. The podcaster Joe Rogan raises it with Michels, passing on what he says a man named Bart Sibrel has: uncovered footage in which the crew say they are hundreds of thousands of miles out, or halfway there. If true, it would mean that at least part of the trip was staged for the camera.
